methodology.rank: Each version own prior-calendar-year expanding midrank; minimum252; strict>80%.
methodology.timer: t+2 native oil sessions;20-session reset on each eligible trigger; one long; no continuous-trigger requirement; missing does not reset; latest row not forcibly closed.
methodology.unknown: Unknown inputs stay null; existing timer still counts down. Missing rank is not a low reading.
methodology.history: Prices/factors available from2014-10-09; no15-year complete-history claim. Backtest rules start2021; earlier price/factor context is not a validated strategy track record.
methodology.metric: Frozen arithmetic net annualization / daily raw opening notional, not compounded NAV or margin ROI; $45/side,$90/roll. No backtest rerun.
methodology.source: Databento CME futures and options from existing locally audited snapshots; sources are read-only.
